text_block_list.text:
Our classic-year spring is over and
summer camp
season has arrived!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Time! For! A! Refresh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer! I wasn't my usual self
after the
Derby!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's not like me to worry so much! After
all, I'm a
child of the sun!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Niña del sol!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yet I'm always fretting over the same problem. What should I do to really become the world's strongest? What do I need to do?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But if I gotta worry all the same, I might
as well
do it with a smile at camp!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If nothing else, it seems like she's
cheered up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But is it okay for you to just up and go
to camp,
El?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: If we both go, what happens to Mambo?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh... Um, nothing... Whoops...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Mambo is my pet condor!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: El! Geez! You can't just tell your trainer!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
We aren't allowed to have pets in the
dorms...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: So that's the name of El's condor?

text_block_list.text:
Yes, but he's not actually a condor. He's
a hawk.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No hay problema, Grass! You don't have
to worry
about Mambo!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But what about his food? He eats so
much...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: You'll see once we leave.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Vrooooom!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so the bus departs, leaving her pet
behind...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, look out the window, Trainer!
There, up
in the sky!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Caaaaaw!
text_block_list.name: Mambo

text_block_list.text: Ah, Mambo!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Mambo, bueno! Way to go! Head
straight for
camp!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A trip like this is no problem for the
wings of a
condor!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It turns out her pet doesn't need to ride
the bus
to come along. It seems there's
nothing to worry
about.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Caaaaaw!
text_block_list.name: Mambo

text_block_list.text:
That piercing, resonant screech is
undoubtedly
the cry of a hawk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
